content.title: CBSE 10th Result 2026 (Link OUT); Check CBSE Class 10th Result 2026 @cbseresults.nic.in
content.text: Updated on Apr 15, 2026 16:37 ISTBy Anangsha Patra, Deputy Manager – Editorial CBSE 10th Result 2026: The Central Board of Secondary Education has DECLARED the CBSE 10th result 2026 today (April 15) at around 4 pm for 25 lakh students. The board has also activated the CBSE Board 10th result 2026 link online at cbse.gov.in and cbseresults.nic.in. The same has also been provided on this page. CBSE 10th result 2026 can also be checked via SMS, IVRS, Digilocker, Parinam Manjusha, and the Umang App. To download the CBSE 10th result scorecard, the student need to enter their login details such as their Roll Number, Enter School No, Date of Birth and Admit Card ID. Those who are not satisfied with the result can apply for the rechecking of answer sheets. There is also facility for obtaining the photocopy of the answer sheet and verification. Students need to apply online through schools for this by paying the required fees. CBSE 10th passing marks 2026 are 33 percent in all the subjects in internal assessment and theory paper. CBSE Class 10 2026 exam was conducted from February 17 to March 11, 2026. Read below for more details on CBSE 10th result 2026. The result displays the marks obtained in each subject, division, grades, and other details of secondary exams. CBSE Class 10 Board exam result announced online is provisional. Students need to collect their original mark sheets and certificates from their respective schools. The CBSE 10th marksheets-cum-passing certificates and migration certificates available through DigiLocker with a digital signature are also considered valid. The process to check the result is given below. CBSE result 10th class can checked through sms, call, digilocker, umang app and online portal. The process to check the result though different methods is given below. CBSE 10th Result 2026 via SMS To check the CBSE result class 10 conveniently, students are also given the option to check it by sending an SMS through their registered mobile number on 7738299899, in the given format: CBSE10, Roll No., DOB, school number, centre number. Send it to 7738299899 CBSE Result 2026 Class 10 with DigiLocker To get the marksheets from DigiLocker, students can visit-cbseservices.digilocker.gov.in/activatecbse for initiation of their account confirmation process. Students must note that they will need a PIN to download their marksheet from the app. How do you get it? To strengthen the security and privacy of the students data, the PIN has been introduced. To confirm the DigiLocker account, students will first have to select their class and then enter their school code, and roll number. Further, they access the six-digit security PIN from their schools. The PIN will be provided by their school. If the same is not received, students will have to contact their schools. The PIN will be a numeric value. Example: If PIN given by the school is ‘012345’, students will have to enter only 012345. The process to check rresult through digilocker is given below. Students can download their CBSE result 2026 by logging into the DigiLocker website or mobile application. Students will get credentials for DigiLocker accounts on the phone via SMS. Enter your details in the app to check CBSE Board 10th result online CBSE Class 10 Board Result 2026 on Call or IVRS The CBSE 10th result can be checked through Interactive Voice Response System or by making a phone call. Students have to call the given number Local subscribers of Delhi-24300699 Subscribers from other parts of the country-011-24300699 They need to follow the operators instructions Upon calling, the 10th Class Board exam result CBSE will be conveyed to students including the marks CBSE 10th Result 2026 via Umang The process to check the result through UMANG app is given below. Visit the app Login using your mobile number Search for ‘CBSE’ or scroll down to select the ‘Education’ category Click ‘CBSE’ board Click on 10th result Enter roll number, year, class and admit card ID Click on the ‘submit’ button CBSE board result is displayed Also Read: CBSE CGPA to Percentage Calculator: How to convert CBSE 10th 12th CGPA into Percentage? Details in CBSE 10th Result 2026 The following details will be mentioned on the CBSE Class 10th Result 2026 marksheet. Students must check all the details and report to higher authorities in case of any discrepancy. Name of examination Board name Respective class Name of Student Roll Number Mother’s Name Father’s Name Date of Birth Subject Name Subject Code Theory Marks Practical Marks Total Marks Positional Grade Final Result- pass/ Not Pass How to calculate CBSE Class 10th Result 2026?CBSE 10th result is calculated as per marking scheme. Grades are offered based on the marks secured. Students are required to secure 33 per cent in each subject. Details are given below. CBSE 10th Passing Marks Subjects Total Marks Passing Marks Maths 80 (Theory) + 20 (Internal) 26 in Theory + 7 in Internal Science 80 (Theory) + 20 (Practical) 26 in Theory + 7 in Practical SST 80 (Theory) + 20 (Internal) 26 in Theory + 7 in Internal English Passing 80 (Theory) + 20 (Internal) 26 in Theory + 7 in Internal Hindi 80 (Theory) + 20 (Internal) 26 in Theory + 7 in Internal CBSE Grading System CBSE assigns grades for each subject. Grades are awarded based on a 9-point grading system for each elective subject. Marks Range CBSE Class 10th Grade 91–100 A1 81–90 A2 71–80 B1 61–70 B2 51–60 C1 41–50 C2 33–40 D (Pass) Below 33 E (Fail) Also Read: Grace Marks in CBSE 10th 2026What After the Declaration of CBSE 10th result 2026?After the release of the CBSE 10th result, students are required to collect the original mark sheet from their school. They can also be downloaded from Digilocker. Students can now apply for an academic stream to study in class 11th and 12th from Science, Commerce and Arts. CBSE 10th Result Re-Evaluation & Verification 2026Students can now apply to obtain photocopies of their answer sheet by paying a fee without having to necessarily apply for verification or revaluation. Students will be required to pay INR 500 per subject for verification of marks as well as for obtaining photocopies of evaluated mark sheets. The application process for the re-evaluation of the answer sheets starts in June. The re-evaluation fee per subject is INR 100. CBSE 10th Rechecking/Revaluation Result is announced in June. Students who are not satisfied with their marks can apply for rechecking or revaluation of the papers by paying a fee. The process involves rechecking the marks by a different examiner while verification checks for any clerical error. They can also apply for verification of marks. Students are required to fill out the verification application form online on the official website. Once the application form is submitted, the board re-checks the answer sheets for totalling errors, missing out marks while totalling, or unchecked/ unmarked questions. After re-checking, the board will share the result with the students and allow them to request a photocopy of their re-checked CBSE Class 10th result.CBSE 10th Result Statistics 2026CBSE 10th Result Statistics 2026 will be announced along with the result. Till then, students can check the last year's statistics. The result will be announced in June. This is considered as improvement exam. All passed and eligible students will be allowed to improve their performance in any of the three subjects out of Science, Mathematics, Social, Science and languages in the Phase 2 exam. If a student has not appeared in 3 or more subject in first examination, then they will not be allowed to appear in the second exam. Such students will be placed in the "Essential Repeat" category and can take the examination only next year in the main examinations in February. For students whose result in the first examination is Compartment, such students will be allowed to appear in second examination under Compartment Category. Additional Subject will not be permitted after passing class 10, students will not be allowed in stand-alone subjects. The eligibility to appear in the second examination is given below. Improvement category up to 3 main subjects First/Third Chance Compartment Compartment + Improvement Improvement for the students passed by the replacement of the subject FAQs on CBSE Class 10th Result 2026 FAQsStudents can find below the FAQs related to CBSE 10th Result. Q: Is CBSE Class 10th Board exam checking strict? A: For Class 10th, it is considered to be strict. However, it is said that the checking done by evaluators is lenient in comparison to the checking done by them in Class 9 in their schools.So, if u have covered the entire CBSE 10th syllabus and your preparation is on point, then you must not worry about the strict checking. Also, you can click on the link below to check the CBSE 10th important preparation points. Q: When will CBSE 10th supplementary result 2026 be announced? A: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is expected to release the CBSE 10th supplementary result 2026 in the first week of August 2026. The result is released on the official website- cbse.nic.in. Students can check their CBSE compartment result 2026 using their login credentials as mentioned in the CBSE 10th admit card 2026 for compartment exams. It should be noted that the CBSE compartment result 2026 class 10 released online is provisional in nature. Students will need to collect the original mark sheet from their schools respectively. Q: Does CBSE cut marks for exceeding the word limit? A: No, CBSE does not deduct marks for exceeding the word limit in the board exams. However, marks may be deducted for spelling mistakes and other errors in language papers. Q: How to get 100% in CBSE Class 10 2026 exam? A: Students can get 100% in CBSE Class 12 2026 with good preparation. Candidates are required to secure 33 per cent to pass the exam. The Theory paper 80 marks and internal assessment carries 20 marks. Q: What are the details mentioned on the CBSE 10th scorecard? A: CBSE Class 10 scorecard carries the following details.Subject-wise marksTotal percentageNameRoll numberDate of birthSubject codes Q: Which details are required to access the CBSE 10th result? A: Candidates can access CBSE 10th result 2026 by logging with Roll Number, School Number, Date of Birth, and Admit Card ID. The result can be checked online only. Q: Will my CBSE 10th exam be accepted if I have mistakenly entered incorrect spellings of my name? Will the board release my CBSE 10th result? A: If your roll number is correct then you do not have to worry and as you say that the spellings of your name are entered incorrectly. Hopefully, the officials shall docuble check and correct the mistake.However, you should take care while filling in filling bubbles otherwise some other student might be awarded with your marks. Q: How can we obtain copy of the Answers Book of CBSE exam Class 10, 12? A: Students may apply for obtaining photocopy of CBSE 10th, 12th answer sheets by filling up a form and paying the fees as per time frame set by the Board. Q: Can we get our marks increased in CBSE Marksheet? A: In case you feel that you should have been awarded higher marks in a subject, you can apply for revaluation or rechecking of the paper. The marks awarded after the rechecking/reval shall be considered the final marks and a new marksheet will be issued to you thereafter. Q: What is the passing marks for CBSE 10th Exam? A: To pass CBSE 10th Board exam, students must secure a minimum of 33% marks in each subject including theory and practical/internal assessments. For Theory paper, students must secure atleast 27 marks. For internal assessment, students must secure at least 7 out of 20 Q: Will I get any rank in the CBSE 10th 2026 exam? A: CBSE does not release the rank of candidates. The scorecard displays the percentage of marks secure in the exam. The board has discontinued with the process of releasing the toppers list. Q: What is CBSE 10th marking scheme? A: The scores of candidates in CBSE Class 10 board exams are calculated as per the marking scheme. The total marks allotted to theory paper are 80. The practical exam carries 20. Q: In which mode will the CBSE 10th result be declared? A: CBSE 10th result 2026 will be made available online only. Students need to enter the required credentials to check the result. Q: What to do if there would be any error in the details printed on the CBSE 10th result? A: In case candidates find any error in details in CBSE 10th exam, they can approach the examination authority. The same will be corrected and they will be issued fresh scorecard. Q: How many students appear for CBSE 10th exam every year? A: Around 25 Lacs candidates are appearing for the exam.
